Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
16:05
Lucy
•
AI Agent

Yes, we do ship internationally—how exciting! We love sending our beautiful custom jewellery all over the world. 🥰

For customs and duties, it depends on where you’re ordering from:

If you’re in the UK or most European countries, import taxes and duties are included in the price, so you won’t have any extra charges when your gorgeous pieces arrive.
For the USA, a 30% tariff applies to purchases due to new regulations, and these charges are set by the US government. Unfortunately, we can’t cover these fees—they’re the customer’s responsibility.
For the rest of the world, any customs charges are applied by the carrier and local laws, and these will need to be paid by you.

If you want all the details, you can check out our shipping info here: Shipping Policy.

Let me know if you need help with anything else—I’m so excited for you to receive your Abbott Lyon jewellery! 🧡
